description.value: Lucha Libre Taqueria — now reimagined as Lucha Libre Barra — is a Mexican street-food and cocktail bar in Vancouver's downtown core, built around the bold vintage aesthetic of classic Lucha Libre wrestling culture, with retro posters, masked-hero iconography, and mid-century Mexican décor. The kitchen serves street-style tacos alongside creative cocktails in a lively bar atmosphere, with online ordering and a catering service available. The venue is part of the Original's Mexicano restaurant group, which operates several related Mexican concepts across Metro Vancouver.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the business is active at 722 Nelson St with phone (604) 620-8981, matching OSM contact data; address and phone are cross-confirmed. The website refers to the venue throughout as 'Lucha Libre Barra', indicating a rebrand from the OSM-listed name 'Lucha Libre Taqueria'. OSM tag takeaway=yes is corroborated by the website's prominent 'ORDER ONLINE' feature, but no cycling-specific amenities — bike parking, water refill, or washrooms — are mentioned anywhere in the website content or OSM tags, leaving all required criteria null.
concerns: Website refers to the establishment throughout as 'Lucha Libre Barra', suggesting a rebrand or concept change from the OSM-listed name 'Lucha Libre Taqueria'; OSM name may be outdated.

Opening hours shown on the website (weekdays from 5 pm) conflict significantly with OSM opening_hours tag (Su-We 11:00-22:00, Th-Sa 11:00-02:30); the /contact subpage shows yet a third set of hours including an apparent typo ('Mon to Thurs: 11 AM - 12:00 PM'). OSM hours should not be relied upon.
OSM tag diet:vegetarian=yes is not corroborated by any explicit mention on the website; marked null per verification rules.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The business is clearly active and would serve touring cyclists as a food stop, but none of the three required WWC criteria (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) can be confirmed from available evidence. Direct contact or a site visit is needed before listing.
enrichment_extras.notes: Email address luchalibre@originalsmexicano.com found on website (not in OSM). Business is part of the Original's Mexicano group also operating Original's Mexicano (Port Moody), Osteria Povera (Port Moody), Mercado Mexicano (Coquitlam), Mercado Bakery (Hastings), and Pantitlán (Hastings).
